The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC

Buyer Added text based ATC clauses TERMS & CONDITIONS For Supply, Installation and Commissioning of Biochemistry Analyser Machine (Semi automated) 1. The bidder shall provide a live demonstration of the Biochemistry Analyser, if required, during techni cal evaluation. 2. Rates should be quoted for a good-quality Biochemistry Analyser (Semi automated) strictly as per t he technical specifications mentioned in the tender document. 3. The bidder's firm/company must have its registered office located in Gujarat, within the geographic al area of Gujarat. Valid documentary proof of the registered office must be submitted along with th e quotation. 4. The bidder must submit a valid GST registration certificate, PAN card and relevant business registrat ion documents along with the quotation. 5. The bidder shall submit an authorization certificate from the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM ), wherever applicable. 6. The bidder must submit a declaration stating that the firm/company is not blacklisted or debarred b y any Government Department, Government Institution or Public Sector Undertaking. 7. The supplied machine must strictly conform to the prescribed technical specifications. No alternativ e specifications or inferior-quality equipment will be accepted. 8. The quoted price shall be inclusive of all applicable taxes, GST, transportation, loading, unloading, i nstallation and commissioning charges. 9. The supplier shall provide free installation, demonstration and necessary operational training to the concerned laboratory staff, including training for sample processing, calibration, quality control and routine maintenance. 10. The supplier shall provide a minimum two-year comprehensive warranty from the date of successful installation and commissioning, including spare parts, labour and service charges. 11. The supplier shall provide a three-year Comprehensive Maintenance Contract (CMC) after completio n of the warranty period. It shall include preventive maintenance, breakdown services, labour charg es, necessary spare parts and technical support without any additional cost to the institution. 12. The supplier must ensure prompt after-sales service. Service complaints should preferably be atten ded to within 24–48 hours of reporting. 13. The supplier shall provide all necessary operating manuals, technical documents, calibration details, maintenance guidelines and quality-control procedures along with the machine. 14. The supplier shall ensure the availability of compatible reagents, calibrators, quality-control materia ls, cleaning solutions and other essential consumables required for the smooth functioning of the Bi ochemistry Analyser (Semi automated). 15. Any damage, shortage or breakage during transportation shall be the sole responsibility of the suppl ier and shall be replaced without any additional cost. 16. No advance payment shall be made. Payment shall be processed only after successful delivery, inst allation, commissioning, inspection and satisfactory performance of the machine. 17. The bidder must submit a written undertaking confirming the availability of comprehensive CMC ser vices for three years after completion of the warranty period. 18. The supplier shall provide necessary calibration and quality-control certificates/documents, whereve r applicable, and demonstrate satisfactory functioning of the equipment, including accuracy and pre cision of test results, before final acceptance. 19. The bidder shall comply with all applicable statutory and regulatory requirements for the supply of medical diagnostic equipment in India. 20. All disputes shall be subject to the jurisdiction of the competent court at Navsari, Gujarat. 21. The bill shall be processed only after complete inspection, successful installation, commissioning an d satisfactory observation of the machine by the concerned authority. 22. Earnest money deposit of 4500/- to given in the name of " ADHYAKSHREE ROGI KALYAN SAMITI SDH COT". .
